title: Mythos: The AI That Hunts Zero-Days
excerpt: Anthropic's secretive Mythos model chained two ordinary-looking bugs into a critical auth bypass — then attackers exploited it within 24 hours of disclosure. This is what machine-speed vulnerability research looks like.

title: EASM: Mapping Your Attack Surface Before Attackers Do
excerpt: Most organizations aren't breached through the front door, but through assets they didn't even know existed. EASM is the discipline of finding them first.
